comment: This delay is monophonic: unlike the other Surge XT effects it has no polyphonic mode, and it adds no block latency. The clock input is read as a trigger, high above 1V, with Clock in QuarterNotes chosen on the menu; with Clock in BPM CV chosen the voltage sets the tempo instead, doubling it per volt.
